Front: Black screen or "No signal": check first
Back: The input source, then the cable

Front: Fuzzy, stretched or distorted image: fix
Back: Set the native resolution

Front: Dead pixel: can it be fixed?
Back: Usually not. Replace the screen if there are many
OLED screens (a static image left too long)

Front: Projector shuts off, then works after resting
Back: Overheating. Clean the filters and vents

Front: Projector gives no picture, lamp-hours counter is high
Back: Burnt-out bulb. Replace the lamp (let it cool first)

Front: LCD very dim, picture is faintly visible
Back: Failing backlight or inverter

Front: No sound over a video cable
Back: VGA and DVI carry no audio. Use HDMI or DisplayPort, or check the output device

Front: Wrong colors on a VGA screen
Back: Loose cable or bent pins

Front: Swollen battery: what do you do?
Back: Stop using it, do not charge it, do not puncture it, replace it safely and recycle it. Fire risk

Front: Touch does not respond but the picture is fine
Back: Digitizer fault

Front: Touches land in the wrong place
Back: Restart, remove the screen protector, recalibrate touch

Back: Malware. Remove the apps, scan
